approval_history.note:
Redesign to closely match the four supplied Global Search mockups. Preserve LLCBookKeepingPrivate's deep emerald header, navy text, white background, pale-green accents, rounded cards, and five-tab navigation.
Implement ONE Global Search with five states:
Home: Search bar, category grid, recent searches.
Results: Grouped matches, counts, amounts, dates, and detail navigation.
Filters: Date, amount, account, member, category, project, status, and record type; Apply/Clear.
Details: Open existing record screens; preserve search state on return.
No Results: Helpful empty state with Clear Filters.
Search Transactions, Categories, Accounts, Members, Capital, Payments, Loans, Reminders, Reconciliations, and Period History.
UX: Mobile-first cards, readable text, persistent search, scrollable filter chips, no wide tables or clipped content.
Functionality: Use actual persisted records, restrict results to the selected LLC, work offline, preserve audit history, and never modify financial data through search. No fabricated values or decorative nonfunctional categories.
Acceptance: Capture actual iOS/Android screenshots, compare against references, verify all supported search/filter/navigation flows, and preserve existing bookkeeping functionality. Do not mark complete based on appearance alone.
